name: Lure
author: Erin Carter
description: Near-total darkness with sparse marine snow sinking straight down, until a rare long-cycle event reveals a whale-scale deep-sea silhouette traced entirely by rows of photophores. The anglerfish lure bulb ignites first, then light spreads tail-ward into a frame-wide dotted body that glides and shimmers before extinguishing back into black.

params.label: Event period
params.effect: Seconds of the full dark-to-dark cycle — short values audition the apparition quickly, long values make each passage feel rare.

params.label: Body span
params.effect: Nose-to-tail length of the silhouette in CSS pixels; photophore spacing, dot size, and the lure bulb all scale with it.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Twinkle amplitude of the lit rows — 0 holds every dot steady, 2 sends rolling waves of brightness along the body.
